notes: Official page is http-only. Fetched via curl: the menu has only BOULBAKA2 (the BOULBAKA1 menu cell and the 'boulbaka1' gallery section are empty), all hours/prices/parking are for BOULBAKA2, and the footer still lists '882 AMEKU NAHA tel 098 988 4550' with no hours or closure notice. Our Naha pin (26.2122,127.6791) is just the Naha city node; GSI puts '882 Ameku' at 26.237066,127.684242, so the pin was wrong regardless. BOULBAKA2 (Urasoe) is the live gym; I could not check whether it is already in our data (data/ is off limits) so de-dupe before adding. Hours: site says weekday 13:00-22:00, weekend/holiday 10:00-19:00, closed Friday (open if a public holiday); I mapped weekday to Mon-Thu.
